tasks.title: Tighten post-task-reviewer path-scoped allowlist
tasks.description: TDD in one task. Step 1: add a failing assertion to test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts using the existing mock-spawn pattern. Find the test that captures the args array passed to spawn by spawnPostTaskReviewer. Add an assertion that the args array contains '--allowedTools' immediately followed by the EXACT string 'Read,Glob,Grep,Edit(.ralph/review-post.md),Write(.ralph/review-post.md)'. The current production value at src/post-task-reviewer.ts:124 is 'Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write' — confirm the test fails against the current value (that's the TDD verification). Step 2: change the --allowedTools value in src/post-task-reviewer.ts:119-129 from 'Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write' to 'Read,Glob,Grep,Edit(.ralph/review-post.md),Write(.ralph/review-post.md)'. This activates Claude Code's path-scoped allowlist enforcement (verified April 2026 — https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions.md): Edit and Write outside .ralph/review-post.md will be denied before hitting disk. No other changes to the file. Make the new test pass without regressing any other post-task-reviewer tests.
tasks.notes: Updated --allowedTools from 'Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write' to 'Read,Glob,Grep,Edit(.ralph/review-post.md),Write(.ralph/review-post.md)' in src/post-task-reviewer.ts:123. Added a TDD assertion to the existing 'spawns claude with correct args' test — confirmed it failed against the old value before the fix, passes after. All 658 tests green.

tasks.title: Tighten post-task-reviewer prompt (belt-and-suspenders)
tasks.description: Add an explicit rule near the top of agents/post-task-reviewer.md: a new line stating 'You may only write to .ralph/review-post.md — never modify .ralph/tasks.json.' This is defense-in-depth alongside the path-scoped allowlist from task 12 (the allowlist is the authoritative enforcement; the prompt keeps the agent from even trying). Preserve the existing '## Output Format' and '## Coverage Diagram' sections verbatim — do not reword or restructure them. Smoke-read the file after editing to confirm it still reads as a coherent agent prompt (no orphaned fragments, no broken section headers).

tasks.title: Document ralph task workflow in CLAUDE.md
tasks.description: Add a short 4-6 line section to CLAUDE.md under the 'Conventions' section (or a new 'Agent workflow' subsection if cleaner) explaining: agents must use the ralph task subcommand group (start, complete, note, set-status, add, show) for every mutation of .ralph/tasks.json; direct Edit/Write on .ralph/tasks.json is forbidden and is caught by the per-agent prompt ban plus the path-scoped allowlist on the post-task reviewer; the CLI ensures atomic writes and JSON validity so corruption becomes structurally impossible via this path. Keep the addition tight — do not rewrite the existing 'Architecture' or 'Key design patterns' sections; only add the new guidance.

tasks.title: Full-suite verification + build + manual corruption-recovery smoke test
tasks.description: Final verification task. Step 1: run 'bun test' — full suite must pass green. Step 2: run 'bun run build' — must produce a fresh dist/ralph without errors. Step 3: manual checks on a scratch project (create a throwaway dir with a hand-written tasks.json): (3a) run 'ralph task start 1 --iteration 1' then 'ralph task complete 1 --iteration 1 --notes "manual smoke"' then 'ralph task note 1 "appended"' then 'ralph task note 1 --replace "replaced"' — after each command, cat tasks.json and verify it parses as valid JSON. (3b) Deliberately break tasks.json (delete a comma after a notes field in any task); run 'ralph run' on the scratch project for one iteration; verify readTasksFile recovered via jsonrepair (look for the success path continuing) and that <dataDir>/corruption.log contains a new entry with stage:'jsonrepair'. (3c) Delete BOTH tasks.json AND .ralph/.ralph_tasks_snapshot.json; run 'ralph run' — verify TasksFileError is surfaced (not a silent failure) and the corruption.log entry records the complete fail. (3d) In a separate scratch repo with review.postTask enabled, trigger a post-task review and verify the reviewer cannot Edit .ralph/tasks.json — the Edit call should be denied by Claude Code's path-scoped allowlist; confirm by reading the stream-json output for a permission_denied event. Record all four results in the task's notes on completion. If any step fails, leave the task in-progress and document the failure in notes for the next iteration.
